Browser bitmap preview surface published: f5dc2e249bbeebf3e1e42c4d2667f183f7c1d72d

Added a usable local browser surface over the qualified Rust decoder and real WASM executable: local file loading, sample, zoom and selectable region outlines/list. One owned opaque sample is accepted/canonicalized by the pinned native RenderPayload decoder. Host/WASM packets agree, and actual Canvas readback SHA-256 matches all 49,152 expected RGBA bytes. Scale-two file loading and Orange selection at 400% zoom were observed in the browser; a screenshot and final DOM receipt are saved.

Validation: 399 Rust tests; actual WASM worker host-packet identity, malformed rejection and unknown-import rejection; fresh disposable native/source/build/worker replay passed. Default offline viewer startup passed in approved loopback context. Original packet/presentation/selection policy remains distinct from recovered native behavior. Accessibility blobs remain opaque; no arbitrary SwiftUI rendering, native Canvas interaction, general alpha/color parity or provider/OS resource settlement claimed. M1 and M2 remain incomplete.

Sanitized evidence and replay: `research/evidence/browser-preview-surface-2026-10-27`; usage: `tools/re/browser-preview/README.md`. Raw Apple disassembly remains local. Concrete UI-tool latency, proxy and sandbox limitations are preserved. Next: connect missing provider/resource semantics and qualify further native Canvas behavior.
